obligation: Customer A incident notice and response coordination (row 1)
citation: Customer A Contractor Cyber Security Exhibit S4 (flows down CIP-013-2 R1.2.1 and R1.2.2 from Customer A's utility contracts)
trigger: Discovery of a cyber incident that affects or could affect Customer A's systems or information, or a device used on Customer A equipment (the service laptop and USB sticks count)
deadline: Within 24 hours of discovery; then coordinate the response with Customer A
notify: Customer A plant controls engineer by phone, then in writing (email from a clean device)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - binding by contract. The 24 hours is Customer A's contract term, not a NERC deadline

obligation: Customer A notice of a firmware hash mismatch
citation: Customer A exhibit S5 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.5 flow-down); POL-01 7.4
trigger: Hash value of firmware or software for Customer A or utility equipment does not match
deadline: Same day; do not load the file

obligation: Customer B and C notice of unauthorized disclosure (row 3)
citation: Customer B and C mutual NDAs
trigger: Unauthorized disclosure of the customer's confidential information (for example, its programs on an encrypted-then-stolen laptop, or exfiltration by ransomware)
deadline: Prompt written notice (no fixed number of days in the NDAs; the owner targets 24 hours, the same as Customer A)
notify: Customer B maintenance supervisor and plant management; Customer C contact named in the NDA

obligation: Courtesy notice to the seven local plants
trigger: Their programs or passwords were on the affected laptop or a stick
deadline: No legal deadline; same day as Customer A as good practice
applies_at_this_tier: Recommended - no contract or legal duty, but their passwords may be exposed

obligation: Customer A notice when a person should no longer have utility site access
citation: Customer A exhibit S6 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.3 flow-down)
trigger: Anyone working for the business should no longer have utility site access
applies_at_this_tier: Not today - the owner works alone; applies if a helper or subcontractor is ever used

obligation: Utility reports under NERC CIP or Form DOE-417
citation: NERC CIP Reliability Standards; Form DOE-417
applies_at_this_tier: No - these duties belong to the utility (a NERC-registered entity). The owner's part is the Customer A notice in row 1

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident report / ransom payment report (PROPOSED - not yet in effect)
citation: 6 U.S.C. 681b; proposed 6 CFR 226.5 (proposed; critical manufacturing criterion)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment by a covered entity
deadline: 72 hours after reasonable belief a covered cyber incident occurred; 24 hours after ransom payment disbursed (proposed)
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-09-25; as proposed it would not cover this business (SBA-small; repair is not manufacturing under proposed 226.2(b)(3)). Recheck when final

trigger: Any significant cyber incident, especially one touching critical manufacturing customers
applies_at_this_tier: Yes, voluntary - recommended after coordinating with Customer A so the reports match
Yes, voluntary - also a mitigating factor if a ransom payment is ever considered

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (Sept. 21, 2021); 31 CFR ch. V
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if sanctioned party); law enforcement (FBI) or CISA
applies_at_this_tier: All U.S. persons. Strict liability for payments to sanctioned parties

trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Unlikely - the FSBS holds business contact details of customer staff, which are not personal information under 501.171 unless combined with, for example, an account password. Counsel confirms for each incident

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach
notify: Florida Department of Legal Affairs (Attorney General)
applies_at_this_tier: No - the business holds far fewer than 500 individuals' personal information

trigger: Affected individuals who reside outside Florida
notify: Residents and regulators under each state's law
applies_at_this_tier: Unlikely - customers and their staff are in Florida; check residency if personal information is involved

obligation: DoD cyber incident reporting for covered defense information
trigger: Cyber incident affecting covered defense information
deadline: Within 72 hours of discovery ('rapidly report'); preserve images 90 days
applies_at_this_tier: No - no DoD contracts or subcontracts and no covered defense information

obligation: Covered telecommunications equipment or services discovered
trigger: Contractor identifies covered telecommunications equipment or services
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification (further report within 10 business days)
applies_at_this_tier: No - no federal contracts or subcontracts

trigger: Contractor identifies a covered article (Kaspersky Lab hardware, software, or services)
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification (further report within 10 business days)
applies_at_this_tier: No - no federal contracts or subcontracts
Not today - no cyber policy (cyber liability required by Customer A from 2027-09-30, exhibit S8). If a customer claims damage, notify the general liability carrier under that policy's terms
